# Install packages for the 2026 demos and labs

Run the chunk below once before working through the 2026 SISBID unsupervised learning demos and labs. The code checks which packages are already installed and only installs the missing packages.

```{r install-packages, eval=FALSE}
options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cran.rstudio.com"))

cran_packages <- c(
  "cluster",
  "fastICA",
  "GGally",
  "ggplot2",
  "ggrepel",
  "glasso",
  "glmnet",
  "huge",
  "igraph",
  "ISLR",
  "ISLR2",
  "knitr",
  "mclust",
  "NMF",
  "pheatmap",
  "Rtsne",
  "rmarkdown",
  "sda",
  "umap"
)

install_if_missing <- function(pkgs) {
  is_installed <- vapply(pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
  missing_pkgs <- pkgs[!is_installed]

  if (length(missing_pkgs) == 0) {
    message("All requested packages are already installed.")
  } else {
    message("Installing: ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "))
    install.packages(missing_pkgs)
  }
}

install_if_missing(cran_packages)
```
